Signs You Need Septic Service

If you notice any of the issues below, it may be time to schedule septic service in Abbotsford to inspect the system, prevent further damage, and keep everything working safely and efficiently.

– Slow drains or gurgling pipes
– Sewage odors inside or outside
– Wet spots or pooling water near the tank or drainfield
– Toilets backing up
– Unusually lush grass around the septic area
– It’s been several years since your last pump-out

How Often Should You Schedule Septic Tank Pumping in Abbotsford?

Service frequency depends on your tank size, household size, water usage, and the age and condition of the system. For many Abbotsford properties, septic tank pumping every 3 to 5 years is a smart baseline, but some systems need more frequent service, especially on larger households, farms, or high-use properties.
